high_level_description: A clean, modern business card layout for a tech startup, white card with a single accent block of brand blue in the upper right, two text elements placed with intentional asymmetric balance.

style_description.lighting: even, diffuse studio lighting with a soft drop shadow under the card
style_description.art_style: flat vector design, generous whitespace, sans-serif typography, subtle paper texture

compositional_deconstruction.background: A solid off-white card surface with a subtle paper-grain texture, edges softly shadowed. A solid brand-blue rectangular accent block fills the upper right quadrant.

elements.desc: Bold dark-grey sans-serif company name set in the lower-left two-thirds, all caps, tight letter-spacing.
Small brand-blue sans-serif contact email below the company name, sentence case.
